form-section.purpose: Structure related form fields into a titled, validated, saveable group without turning every field group into a full process.
useWhen: A form needs a clear section boundary with helper copy.
Fields share validation, disabled state, or save behavior.
Users need to understand which data belongs together before submitting.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The section is only decorative spacing.
The grouped fields do not share purpose or validation.
The section hides a multi-step process or complex permissions.
foundations: Defines section spacing, field rhythm, action placement, and responsive stacking.
Owns section title, helper copy, validation text, and save labels.
Controls focus, dirty, invalid, disabled, and action states.
Default, dirty, valid, invalid, disabled, saving, and saved states are explicit.
Requires labelled fields, associated validation, keyboard submission, and status feedback.
slots: Names the section and explains purpose.
variants: Grouped fields with explicit save behavior.
Inline validation appears after user action.
motion: Validation appears inline without shifting focus away from the field.
Save confirmation is transient and non-blocking.
accessibility: Save action is reachable by keyboard.
Saved state is announced as feedback.
Disabled fields explain why when needed.
tests: Empty required field shows Inline Validation after save.
Editing field marks the section dirty.
Save reports success when required fields are present.
Responsive viewport stacks fields without overlap.

canDecide: Use Form Section for related fields with shared purpose.
Use Inline Validation for section-level blocking errors.
mustAsk: Required fields, persistence, ownership, or validation timing is unclear.
miel.handoff: Confirm section purpose, required fields, validation timing, save behavior, and success feedback.
